svg.text: The MCP hub IAM entry: one tool call, hop by hop
Who proves what at each hop, and what a caller cannot forge
What the hub verifies, in order
verifies SigV4 · Invoke on this API only
IRSA web identity → 8 h session agent-<id>
SigV4 execute-api · body + SSO token signed · no STS
entry secret → x-caller-arn → actor → SSO token
8 h · session policy: Invoke on this API only
assumable by the backend only · session = actor
A kernel cannot assume the caller role
trust: backend IRSA + backend role only
the gateway overwrites it from the signed identity
A VPC neighbour cannot reach the hub as the gateway
entry secret header · hub SG admits the entry NLB
warmup · session minted by the backend

The actor name is chosen by the backend, where the agent is known · the kernel only signs · the gateway authenticates and stamps the two headers · the hub checks the secret, then the ARN, then the user's SSO token
